name: Tbilisi
tagline: Sulphur baths, balconies and supra feasts
summary: Tbilisi is a characterful capital of carved wooden balconies, sulphur bathhouses and a cliffside fortress. Feast on khachapuri and khinkali, taste ancient qvevri wine and day-trip to Mtskheta and Kazbegi's mountain church.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are best; the autumn grape harvest (Rtveli) is special. Summers are hot.
cashTip: Cards work in Tbilisi; carry lari for markets, marshrutkas and village guesthouses.
